<!-- pr-reviewer: 85b458b83d8ab3b4861f5ee636a2491dec127f3b -->
**Not built - needs a maintainer look** (touches `.github/workflows/release.yml`). No blockers found.

## What looks good
- `release.yml`: triggers unchanged (`push` tags `v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.0` plus `workflow_dispatch`); no `push` branch, `pull_request` or `schedule` trigger added.
- Permissions: workflow default stays `contents: read`; `pages: write` and `id-token: write` appear only on the `pages` job. `site` is `contents: read`.
- Zola is pinned to v0.23.6 with a SHA-256 check. I downloaded the musl tarball and its digest matches `7d77a422...6f`.
- `pages` needs `[site, publish]`, runs only on a `refs/tags/` ref with both results `success`, so it deploys only after the release is published. `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5` and `actions/deploy-pages@v5` exist.
- The tag-vs-`Cargo.toml` version check is sound. Nothing generated is committed (`site/public/`, `site/version.toml` ignored).
- Clean room: no HSMWorks or Autodesk text, structure or assets. The only mentions are the trademark disclaimer in `site/templates/base.html:35-36` and the clean-room paragraph, both allowed. Templates and CSS are original, with no theme.
- Docs claims spot-checked against code and all hold. Checked: `Command` trait and `History` in `crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs:130`; Ctrl+P (`panes.rs:365`); the refusal strings (`posting.rs`, `op_page.rs`, `posting_sim.rs`); the UI labels "Carry stock", "Create first setup", "Export setup sheets", "Detect holes", "Repair mesh", "Load post", "Load machine", "Frame rest", "Frame gouge", "Clear toolpath", "New tool" and "Post refused"; rust-version 1.90; flatpak id `io.github.NeoTech.Camcraft`; the FreeBSD job.
- Body: has `Changelog:`, `Effort: high (no escalation)` and `Refs #688`. The decision file `docs/decisions/688-docs-site.md` is present. The PR touches no process file and no snapshot PNG. No Rust changed.

## Local results
Trial merge with `upstream/main`: clean, already up to date. `zola` is not installed here, so the site was read, not built; the author's `zola build` and `zola check` results are taken from the PR body. Nothing was built or run, since `.github` changed. No cargo gate applies.

## Requested before merge
None blocking. Maintainer to look at: the two new jobs in `.github/workflows/release.yml:440-502`, and the repo settings the PR names (Pages source "GitHub Actions"; environment `github-pages` allowing tags `v*.*.0`). The first tag run cannot be tested before it happens.

## Notes (not blocking)
1. `site/content/guide/posting.md`: "CamCraft ships posts for Fanuc, Haas, Mazak, Sinumerik, Heidenhain, Tormach PathPilot and Fanuc Lathe" omits `assets/posts/carvera.cps`, which also ships.
2. `site/content/developers/crates.md`: `camcraft-kernel` is described as "Shared kernel types". Its header (`crates/kernel/src/lib.rs:1`) says it is the B-rep kernel seam (primitive construction and evaluation), so "B-rep kernel seam" would be more accurate.
3. The body already notes that the AGENTS.md release steps do not name the site step yet. That is fine, but the follow-up process PR will need the `PROCESS_VERSION` bump.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
